reviews.comment: Lectures aren't that great. His explanations aren't clear and sometimes it's hard to understand him. Quizzes are harder than the actual exams and they hurt your grade if you don't do well on them. I recommend using the Math Learning Center and their Week-in-Review. It's a math class, how much you study depends on how good you are in math.
He posts all of his notes on canvas so its easy to relearn topics if you missed a class or two. Overall this class was hard but he tried to make it as easy as possible.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. His teaching style is not effective as his explanations aren't clear. He gives quizzes over stuff that he doesn't go over in class. Uses iClicker for PC. I had to drop this class as I was maybe going to get a low C or high D. I went to multiple WIR, did hw at MLC, and spent more than enough time studying for this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy
